<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Keen Recollection](/Classes.aspx?ID=13)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 54

**Class** Investigator
</column>

---

You can recall pertinent facts on topics that aren't your specialty. Your proficiency bonus to untrained skill checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) is equal to your level instead of +0.
name: Keen Recollection
